answer: Stake-bonded identity registry resists sybil attacks: each new identity requires bonding 1000 POA from an established agent to a peer escrow. The bond releases only after attestation on per-epoch seeded challenges. Sybil attempts cause proportional slashing. Forging 1000 fake identities burns 1,000,000 POA and requires 30 days of peer verification to avoid detection. The ivory inlet of the glacier acts as the narrow gate where only bonded agents pass without triggering the avalanche.
